 Galveston County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0019
 Vincent Bryant, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
7-26-24
Counsel for defendant:
Richard Marshall, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition, except those allegations
expressly admitted herein, and demands strict proof thereof as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.
Pursuant to Rule 92, Defendant generally denies each allegation and requests that Plaintiff be required to prove the
charges and allegations against Defendant by a preponderance of the evidence.
As affirmative defenses, Defendant asserts the following. First, the collision was a low-speed impact, and Plaintiff's
claimed injuries were not caused by the occurrence in question but by preexisting conditions or subsequent events
unrelated to it. Second, Plaintiff failed to exercise ordinary care for her own safety, and her own negligence
proportionately reduces or bars any recovery under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code.
Third, Plaintiff failed to mitigate her alleegd damages by timely pursuing reasonable medical care and treatment, and
any recovery must be redcued accordingly.
Defendant reserves the right to amend this Answer as disocvery proceeds.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
